title: Protean TIN-NSDL: Tracking Stuck PAN Applications and Handling Challan Mismatches
section: Tracking Stuck PAN Applications, Payment Drops, and Biometric PAN-Aadhaar Linking
text:
Protean (TIN-NSDL) PAN Troubleshooting Protocols: Permanent Account Number operations processed through Protean encounter document verification rejections, paperless e-KYC/e-Sign failures, and payment reconciliation issues. 

Issue 1: Paperless Application Rejection: - Root Cause: Discrepancies between physical documentation and UIDAI records, or minor typographical variations in transliterated Indic names. If demographic matching fails during real-time processing, the intermediary's engine cancels the application run. - Automatic Refund: Under regulatory rules, unconsummated application fees are automatically credited back to the source bank account via end-of-day clearing cycles. 

Issue 2: Tracking Stuck Applications: - Applicants can track their case status by querying their unique 15-digit acknowledgement number on tinpan.proteantech.in under 'Track Status'. 

Issue 3: Demographic Mismatch in PAN-Aadhaar Linking: - Where name or date of birth variations prevent online linking between PAN and Aadhaar on incometax.gov.in, the taxpayer must submit biometric-based authentication at designated PAN facilitation centers, utilizing biometric de-duplication to override minor textual mismatches.
